name: Modal
intent: A window over the page for a short task, a form or extra detail. People can always close it.
usage: Use Modal for work that can be dismissed: a short form or extra detail. One component: title, description, body (children) and footer come from props. Put kit Buttons in footer, size sm, secondary first and one primary last. Escape, the close button and a backdrop click all close it. For a must-choose confirm, use AlertDialog. See contracts/modal.json for the full contract. A portaled panel takes the theme of whatever opened it, so it is dark with a dark app frame even though it is drawn at the end of the page.

title.note: 20px bold (text-title-lg). It names the dialog for screen readers.

description.note: One line under the title. Read with the dialog.

icon.note: Material Symbols name shown before the title in the brand color, like PageHeader's icon. Decorative.

size.note: Width 400 / 540 / 768 / 1152 px, or fullscreen. xl is for a table, like a Lookup. Every size shrinks to fit the window. The body scrolls when content is tall.

showClose.note: The × in the header. Escape and a backdrop click still close.

onClose.note: () => void. Runs on Escape, the ×, or a backdrop click.

children.note: The body: text or kit Inputs.

footer.note: Kit Buttons, size sm: secondary first, one primary last.

useWhen: A short form, like editing a customer.
Extra detail that does not need its own page.
doNot: Do not invent Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, ModalCard, Sheet or CommandDialog.
Do not use for a must-choose confirm. Use AlertDialog.
Do not put page navigation or long flows in a modal. Use a page.
Do not put more than one primary Button in the footer.
Do not hide the × unless the footer has a clear way out.
a11y: role=dialog with aria-modal, named by the title and described by the description.
Opening moves focus to the first field in the body, else the × button. Tab stays inside the modal.
Escape closes, unless a menu or search inside handled it first. A backdrop click closes.
Closing returns focus to what had it before. The page behind does not scroll while open.
snippet:
<Modal
  open={open}
  title="Edit customer"
  onClose={close}
  footer={<>
    <Button size="sm" onClick={close}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save</Button>
  </>}
>
  ...
</Modal>

examples.title: Sizes
examples.usage: Pick the smallest width that fits the content.

examples.title: Form
examples.usage: Kit Inputs in the body. Focus starts in the first field; Save is the one primary.
